title: Cracked Out Boyfriend Brutally Assaults His Pregnant Girlfriend
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 1st, 2024. Officers were called to a hotel regarding a man who had assaulted his pregnant 20-year-old girlfriend then fled the scene after. The two did not reside at the hotel but said they were just hanging out there and seemed to be doing crack together. One thing led to another and the couple got into an argument, the man tried to hug the girl however she rejected his hug and thats when things got violent.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
